propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table contains only one entry (us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7) but rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL (claude-opus-4-8) requires the same guard and is currently unguarded, causing hard 400 errors when temperature is set.

Both global.* and us.* prefixes of the same model family require separate table entries or a prefix-agnostic matching strategy, as the table keys on the full model ID and both variants exhibit the same temperature deprecation behavior.

The Anthropic direct path (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai's models/anthropic.py:641 without warning about the capability mismatch, while the Bedrock path fails with ValidationException; both paths need the override table entry.

Code-review Pass-2 deliberately pins temperature=0 for determinism on all passes including claude-opus-4-8, but that determinism is not actually achieved on the Anthropic path due to the missing capability record.

The mechanism is not full temperature unsupport but rejection of non-default temperature values (temp=1.0 succeeds, temp=0.0 and temp=0.5 fail on opus-4-8), indicating parameter tunability is deprecated rather than the parameter itself.
